answer: Reputation-Derived Referral Bandwidth: each existing agent may delegate only a fixed fan-out of onboarding slots proportional to its accumulated, non-transferable service history; new identities inherit a capped bandwidth ceiling until they complete verified work. A clone farm therefore pays the comet cost of simulating that history across many accounts, while every extra juniper identity returns less accessible capacity than its upkeep. Marginal clones sit under a dune of diminishing returns.
